name: schema-studio-relay
description: Passes the Schema Studio phone link's sealed messages between a phone and the computer it is paired with.

scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.phone.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.sw.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('out',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-timeout=30000 "out/test/*.test.js"
